decisions.decision_title: Use neutral readiness evaluation rather than activation runtime.
decisions.justification: Preserves governance before runtime and runtime minimalism.
decisions.trade_offs: Delays execution design until later phases.
decisions.implementation_impact: future code may realize readiness only after governance lock
decisions.certification_impact: certifier must reject activation runtime drift

decisions.decision_title: Use Master Layer Registry as the only ownership registry.
decisions.decision: Blueprint references the Master Layer Registry and forbids parallel registries.
decisions.justification: Prevents duplicate registry and cross-layer ownership.
decisions.trade_offs: Future design must resolve registry gaps through governed registry process.
decisions.future_evolution_guidance: new layer needs separate registry authorization

decisions.decision_title: Require evidence trust envelope before certification.
decisions.decision: Certification evidence must be objective, traceable, and validator-linked.
decisions.justification: Preserves evidence before trust and independent certification.
decisions.trade_offs: Requires more validation artifacts before implementation completion.
decisions.implementation_impact: future implementation must produce evidence envelope inputs
decisions.future_evolution_guidance: evidence can become stricter but not weaker

decisions.decision: Blueprint contains no implementation artifacts and future implementation remains unauthorized.
decisions.trade_offs: Implementation detail waits for later governed phases.
decisions.implementation_impact: future work must wait for Phase 4/5/6
decisions.supersession_rules: cannot be bypassed by blueprint text
